place.name: the European village
place.geography: a European village with cobblestone street, just inside the house

moments.action: The dreamer stands just inside the Meads's house, facing a European village with a cobblestone street.
A Pied-Piper sort of man with curly hair juggles on the cobblestone street.

place.name: the European village
place.geography: a European village with cobblestone street, just inside the house

moments.action: The dreamer stands just inside the Meads's house, facing a European village with a cobblestone street.
A Pied-Piper sort of man with curly hair juggles on the cobblestone street.

place.name: the back stairs and hallway
place.geography: a set of back stairs going up, then straight down another set; a short empty hallway that turns a corner to a tiny room

moments.action: The dreamer goes up the back stairs, then straight down the other side.
The dreamer walks down a short empty hallway and turns a corner to find a tiny room.

place.name: the tiny room
place.geography: a tiny room with a stove that almost fills it

moments.action: A young woman with shoulder-length blonde hair in a pageboy cooks at a stove that almost fills the tiny room; she is nice to the dreamer.
The dreamer waits outside for the aunt; the aunt arrives in a little round convertible.
The dreamer and the aunt drive across a little bridge over a creek, then double back.
The aunt drops the dreamer off at the house again.

place.name: inside, sitting with couple of people

moments.action: The dreamer sits with a couple of people, playing with a string of blue balloons.

place.name: the room
place.geography: a room with an autoclave near where they stood, and a far end

moments.action: The dreamer and the young woman stand talking by the autoclave.
The young woman excuses herself and walks off to the far end of the room.
The young woman stands with an irregular block of glittering ice set upon her shoulders in place of her head.
moments.looks_at: the autoclave side of the room

place.name: the movie theater
place.geography: indoors, rows of seats facing a screen, with one side of seating

moments.action: The dreamer and their girlfriend sit on a blue sofa in a movie theater filled with people sitting on blue sofas.
The large sofa next to the dreamer turns into a roller coaster, like a real one from an amusement park.

place.name: Flooded Library
place.geography: inside a library, flooded with water, with bookshelves, and at one end a huge round window

people.name: the old man in a yellow raincoat

moments.action: The dreamer is sitting in a little wooden rowing boat in a flooded library at night, surrounded by dark green water.
The boat reaches the huge round window with the bright silvery moon filling it, and the old man stops rowing.

place.name: the top of the train
place.geography: high up on top of a train, looking down at a country road and fields

moments.action: Suddenly you are on top of the train, which is now much bigger, going very fast and high up.
moments.looks_at: the flat surface of the train and the sky

moments.action: You see a family sitting on top of the train with you, including a small baby laughing.
The train goes around a bend, and the dreamer is scared they will try to jump off.
moments.looks_at: the bend ahead and the fields below

moments.action: You are on the streetcar, watching the conductor work the lever.

place.name: the glassy outside
place.geography: outside world made of glass, ground underfoot, trees, grass, rocks

moments.action: You walk through the weird glowing blur; trees, grass, and rocks radiate light through the haze.
moments.looks_at: the glowing trees, grass, and rocks through haze
